criteria.reason: The keyboard row renders Copy Last, Done, and Next.
Done uses a flex share of the row rather than full width.
Each action button has a 48px height.
Copy Last calls onChange with the prior set's value for the active field.
Next changes the keypad field from weight to reps.
The button styles use design system color and radius tokens.
The action buttons share a flexible row layout that can fit on mobile.
Button labels contain no exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all existing server and client tests pass.
A new test checks that Copy Last passes the previous value to onChange.
